{{Quote|The big question is, how will the revelations affect Jagged Fel's chances of winning?''"<br />"''Well, Tozz, we'll have our answer when polling closes in just eight hours.|Tozz Relaton and Salia Deradal|<ref name="apocalypse" />}}
'''Salia Deradal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] political commentator for the [[Imperial News Network (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial News Network]]. In [[44 ABY]], Deradal and her partner, [[Tozz Relaton]], covered the report on the [[Raid on Hagamoor 3|destruction]] of [[Natasi Daala]]'s&mdash;a candidate for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|election]]&mdash;campaign headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hagamoor 3]], and how it would affect incumbent [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s chances of winning the election.<ref name="apocalypse" />
